title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN
description: Kanye West tapped industry legends Christian Tresser and Steven Smith for the adidas 700 MNVN. The sneaker's usual mixed-material profile is overhauled in favor of triple-black nylon designed with heat-welded panels and an enlarged 3M '700' graphic along the lateral. title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘MX Sand Grey’ brings progressive slip-on style to little feet. A mostly tan finish, enlivened with swirling hits of brown, grey and coral, suffuses an injected EVA foam build made in part with harvested algae. Strategically placed vents in various shapes and sizes provide enhanced breathability, while a soft top layer on the footbed delivers immediate step-in comfort. Underfoot, a wavy traction pattern yields optimal grip.
